asset_set: Questionnaire Q8 option 1 — Designing streetwear fashion

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under hands and tablet — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle woven-fabric suggestion on swatches via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: expressive confident creative energy — indie streetwear studio, not a corporate fashion house
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text, logos, or brand marks

accent.name: warm yellow
accent.use: sketch accent stripe, stylus tip, jacket cuff stitch

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: yellow appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on stylus tip and tablet edge
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and tablet base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: pins the drawing tablet flat on the drafting table
left_hand.grip: spread fingers, thumb on far edge of tablet
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: draws a bold accent stripe on the hoodie sketch with a stylus
right_hand.grip: precision pinch between thumb and index finger
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering over the tablet screen

pose.gesture_summary: mid-sketch creative flow — one stroke being added
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

top.accent_trim_placement: thin stitch stripe on cuff fold

accessories.item: leather wrist strap with small pin badges
accessories.placement: left wrist, resting near tablet edge

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands sketches a streetwear hoodie design on a drawing tablet, fabric swatches fanned beside it. The left hand steadies the tablet while the right hand adds a bold yellow accent stripe with a stylus, a small mannequin sleeve draped in the actual fabric sitting just behind — capturing the leap from flat sketch to real garment.

primary_objects.name: drawing tablet
primary_objects.detail: screen shows a flat hoodie sketch with a yellow accent line, no readable text

primary_objects.name: fabric swatch fan
primary_objects.detail: three swatches in yellow, lavender, and neutral grey

primary_objects.name: mannequin sleeve
primary_objects.detail: hoodie sleeve fabric visible, no full figure

subject.environment: light drafting table strip across bottom third with a cork pinboard edge and swatch pins, fades to transparent

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from swatch fan → tablet → stylus hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: mannequin sleeve and pinboard edge only
composition.thumbnail_readability: tablet silhouette + swatch fan shape readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter A, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, brand labels, guns, blood
